answer_2.quote: For objective metrics we used WER (using Whisper medium.en as the ASR model), mel‑cepstral distortion (MCD), F0 distance (F0) and energy distance (Energy). We also calculate speaker similarity (SIM) using the WavLM‑TDCNN.

answer_4.quote: For speech editing, the outputs of our model on all 310 utterances from REALEDIT are evaluated by Turkers in terms of naturalness and intelligibility, using a 5‑point Likert scale where 1 means poor and 5 means excellent. We also performed side‑by‑side A/B testing of VOICECRAFT's output against the original (non‑edited) speech, as well as the edited speech produced by FluentSpeech. In both cases, Turkers were asked to determine which utterance sounds more natural.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers rated each sample on naturalness and intelligibility using a Likert scale and performed pairwise comparisons to choose the more natural utterance.
